author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Today’s Mailchimp tutorial for beginners shows you how to run Mailchimp SMS Marketing in 2026 so you can text customers without getting crushed by compliance. 
⚡️ Start texting your customers here ➜ https://mailchimp.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you’ll learn the different Mailchimp plans, what works for SMS, and what extra you'll need to send images with your messages (MMS). 

Next, you’ll go through the SMS registration process - getting a number, registering your use case, and sharing your business info. 

Then, you’ll handle the legal setup—privacy policy and terms—so your list growth doesn’t turn into a liability, and you’ll understand the credit system for payments (1 credit per SMS, 3 for MMS). 

Afterward, you’ll build a way to capture your subscribers' phone numbers using pop-up forms. You'll understand the different template types and how to use the editor to make your forms look visually appealing for you and your subscribers.
